articles.title: Metroid Prime 4 Beyond review: The Samus suit never goes out of fashion even after 18 years
articles.description: Eighteen years adds up to quite the interval. Indeed, it’s not just the wait for the sequel to 2007’s Metroid Prime 3 but also the weight of expectation from a franchise that rarely puts a foot wrong. This is, after all, one of the first videogames to make a hero of a woman – though Samus Aran’s gender is rarely a hot topic in any Metroid.
